definition.name: directional_macro_policy_harm
definition.definition: macro_policy_harm = |treatment_ratio - 1| - |greedy_ratio - 1|; harmful when treatment moves substantially farther from Firestone than greedy, not merely when it differs from greedy.
definition.note: Do not retroactively pass/fail 2n_v3 with this metric. Predeclare for the next fresh evaluation after any Phase 2P fix.
